outcome: number of cardiology tests during pregnancy
length of stay for vaginal delivery patients
level of cardiovascular care (testing, monitoring, specialist care, medication use)
cohort: A cohort of 113 pregnant patients with cardiovascular disease managed by a non-university Cardiovascular Obstetric Program (CVOB) team were compared to 338 similar patients seen by cardiology before the program's implementation.
finding: Implementation of a non-university Cardiovascular Obstetric Program (CVOB) resulted in a more diverse patient population and a higher level of cardiovascular care, including increased testing, monitoring, and specialist visits during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery patients in the CVOB group experienced a half-day longer length of hospital stay.
